name: Tsakos Energy Navigation Limited (TEN Ltd)
note: NYSE-listed (ticker: TEN) energy shipping company incorporated in Bermuda, headquartered in Athens, Greece. The 2026 AGM proxy statement's beneficial-ownership table shows the largest disclosed holders are the Liechtenstein Tsakos Holdings Foundation (with its subsidiaries First Tsakos Investments and Redmont Trading) and Tsakos family members and entities; no state or sovereign fund appears.
